## Public repository safety check

Before merging, confirm:

- [ ] This change contains only intentionally public website/repository content.
- [ ] No application source, client data, private research, internal-only documents, or local configuration is included.
- [ ] No credentials, OAuth secrets, tokens, recovery codes, cookies, or credential files are included.
- [ ] No private account identifiers or internal-only URLs are included unless intentionally public.
- [ ] Changes to CNAME / Pages configuration are intentional.
- [ ] Homepage and Privacy Policy content is appropriate for public access.
